Bill.BriefDescription: Providing access to medical information for physicians.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to access to medical information for physicians;adding a new section to chapter 18.71 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 18.57 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that physicians licensed under thischapter require easy and timely access to medical journals and otherrelated scientific and evidencebased information on a regular basis.The University of Washington library system has over one hundredmedical journals indexed and current, online and in other forms, forall physicians with teaching appointments at the university. Othermaterial critical to ensuring high quality care may be available in thefuture, including certified patient aids for use in shared decisionmaking with patients contemplating treatment options. Washingtonphysicians without these appointments do not currently have access tothese journals and related materials. (2) Physicians licensed under this chapter shall pay a fee oftwentyfive dollars in addition to their annual licensing fee to the p. 1 SB 6083department of health. That money shall be reserved and transferred tothe University of Washington library system by the department toprovide online and other access for all licensed physicians in thestate to the medical journals and related material housed, online,written, or otherwise in the University of Washington library system. (3) The department of health shall provide funds solely from thefees from physicians under this section to the University of Washingtonfor this purpose and shall issue to each licensed physician therequisite passwords and access information in the mailing of his or herannual license.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The University of Washington shall cooperate with the department ofhealth in the implementation of sections 1 and 2 of this act.
